description: This file defines the GetModuleParams class, which extends BaseParam and provides methods to access module-related parameters such as module name, id, and fields. It also configures parameter options using Symfony's OptionsResolver component.

classes.name: GetModuleParams
classes.description: A class representing parameters for retrieving module information, extending BaseParam and providing accessors for specific parameters.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the fields parameter, or null if not set.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Configures allowed parameters using OptionsResolver, specifying module name, id, and fields options.
